definitions.explanation: A selection of different items brought together, or the way things are combined or matched. Often used in food, fashion, and artistic contexts to describe how elements complement each other.

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}の{取|と}り{合|あ}わせがいい。
{季節|きせつ}の{果物|くだもの}の{取|と}り{合|あ}わせを{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered an assortment of seasonal fruits.

examples.japanese: {和菓子|わがし}と{抹茶|まっちゃ}は{最高|さいこう}の{取|と}り{合|あ}わせだ。
examples.english: Japanese sweets and matcha are the perfect pairing.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used to describe aesthetic or culinary pairings. In traditional Japanese arts such as tea ceremony and flower arrangement, the choice of {取|と}り{合|あ}わせ reflects seasonal awareness and artistic sensibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色|いろ}の{取|と}り{合|あ}わせ (color combination)
- {料理|りょうり}の{取|と}り{合|あ}わせ (food assortment)
- {取|と}り{合|あ}わせが{良|よ}い (a good combination)
- {取|と}り{合|あ}わせが{悪|わる}い (a poor combination)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {組|く}み{合|あ}わせ: combination — more general, often used for pairings in competitions or technical contexts
- {盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ: assorted platter — specifically a dish with an assortment of foods
